nodes.title: Developer
nodes.description: Browses architecture maps, from the landscape down to a single file.

nodes.title: Mapping agent
nodes.description: An AI agent following the map-repo skill: reads the graph and the code, writes the map.

nodes.title: Mapped repository
nodes.description: The codebase being mapped; only ever read.

nodes.title: Mapper
nodes.description: Commands that turn a repository into a viewer model: the file graph from code, the map from the agent.

nodes.title: File graph
nodes.description: Application files reached from entry points, and the references between them, in JS/TS, C#, Rust and Java.

nodes.title: Map publishing
nodes.description: Checks a map against the graph, builds the viewer model, and publishes it; also extracts the LikeC4 samples.

nodes.title: Agent commands
nodes.description: graph, check, publish and republish: small commands for agents.

nodes.title: Viewer
nodes.description: The zoomable map: fly from the whole landscape into any element, with relations, routes and lenses.

nodes.title: App shell
nodes.description: Loads a model, runs the frame loop, swaps live updates in, and shows the HUD, details panel and model tabs.

nodes.title: Model
nodes.description: The element tree with relations rolled up per level, synthetic landscapes, and the diff that lets a new version morph in place.

nodes.title: Layout and routing
nodes.description: Packs each container's children in worker threads and routes edges through the gutters between cards.

nodes.title: Rendering
nodes.description: Draws only what the camera sees at its zoom, with lenses (size, coupling, churn) and flight effects.

nodes.title: Video recorder
nodes.description: A second page that encodes frames sent by the recording script into a video with WebCodecs.

nodes.title: Controls
nodes.description: Game-style controls: palette, radial menu, target cycling, routes, pins, minimap and sound.
